Mike Norgate

Michael is a Staff Software Engineer at Cast AI, bringing over eight years of software development experience, with a significant portion of his career spent in the video game industry. Outside of work, he enjoys tinkering with embedded electronics and 3D printing projects. When he’s not coding or building, you’ll likely find him gaming, walking his dogs, or refining his latest 3D print.
